projects.title: TestDino - AI-Powered Test Intelligence Platform
projects.summary: Forward deployed engineering from day one. Architected a SaaS platform for test reporting, observability and test intelligence. Built the backend, led the team, shipped to production.
projects.metrics: Portfolio cites 80+ organizations, 130+ engineers and QAs, 2M+ test executions (disputed, unverified) and 99.95%+ uptime (worst of 7 components, trailing 90 days, as of 2026-09-22). Only the uptime figure is verified.

projects.title: TestGenX - AI-Ready Parallel Test Execution Engine
projects.summary: Built a distributed test execution system from scratch: 200 parallel VMs, 7 hours saved weekly, zero-touch automation (engagement-time figures).

projects.title: Saral - AI-Powered Recruiting Search Platform
projects.summary: Designed the platform architecture and owned backend, infrastructure and the search data flow. Semantic candidate search over 119k profiles with progressive backfill, LLM fallback and per-page credit billing.

projects.title: Driveline TCO - Alternative Drivetrain Comparison & Route Analysis Platform
projects.summary: Client engagement for a Munich automotive firm. Structural improvements to a TCO comparison platform spanning seven drivetrain concepts for heavy commercial vehicles: consumption, total cost of ownership, route feasibility. Bilingual UI, deterministic models, delivered ahead of schedule.

projects.title: @testdino/playwright - Streaming Playwright Results Out of CI
projects.summary: Client half of a CI test-observability platform, published on npm. A Playwright reporter and CLI that streams each result as it completes, with dual-transport failover, byte-aware batching and a liveness heartbeat. Principal author across nine months alongside five other contributors.

projects.title: CaratOS - Stone-Level Cost and Journey Tracking for Diamond Manufacturing
projects.summary: Multi-tenant operations platform for a diamond manufacturer, delivered in 21 days. 27 migrations with paired rollbacks, 54 row-level security policies, and an architecture gate that fails the build on a float column in a money schema.
